cases.ticket: Change the empty-state heading on the saved searches page and update its existing snapshot test.
Add one optional CLI flag that selects JSON output, following the existing formatter and parser patterns, with focused parser tests.
Reject a blank display name in the existing profile validator and add the matching validation test.
Rename the internal retry label shown in status output and update the existing rendering fixture.
Add a missing aria-label to the existing icon-only close button and update the component test.
Handle one additional documented enum value in the existing webhook parser and add a regression fixture.
Expose the already-computed request identifier in the existing debug log line without changing request flow.
Correct the default timeout constant from 25 seconds to 30 seconds and update the unit assertion that pins it.
Add a read-only health field to the existing status response using the value already returned by the service.
Prevent duplicate commas in the existing tag formatter and cover empty and two-tag inputs.
Make the existing date parser reject an impossible calendar day and add one focused regression case.
Add the missing command alias to the current argv router and document the alias in the CLI help text.
Preserve the current query string when the existing pagination control moves to the next page, with one browser test.
Return the existing not-found error when the requested local fixture file is absent instead of throwing a generic error.
Add a bounded warning when the existing configuration uses a deprecated field, without changing its current fallback behavior.

Add organization-scoped API keys: persist hashed keys, enforce organization authorization in the API, expose create and revoke commands, update audit events, and add migration plus integration coverage.
Replace synchronous report generation with a durable background job, status endpoint, retry policy, downloadable artifact storage, and end-to-end tests.
Introduce team invitations across database state, email delivery, accept and expire endpoints, role checks, UI states, and browser coverage.
Add repository branch protection settings that are stored per repository, enforced before publication, surfaced in CLI status, and migrated safely.
Support resumable file uploads with chunk persistence, checksum validation, expiry cleanup, API endpoints, CLI progress, and integration tests.
Implement billing usage limits with metering persistence, request admission checks, operator overrides, provider reconciliation, status visibility, and rollback-safe migration tests.
Add a new OAuth provider including configuration validation, authorization callbacks, token refresh, account linking, provider-specific error handling, and end-to-end fixtures.
Create an audit export pipeline with filters, asynchronous generation, encrypted storage, retention cleanup, authorization, CLI download, and lifecycle tests.
Move notification preferences to per-project settings, migrate existing data, update API and UI editing flows, adjust delivery workers, and prove rollback compatibility.
Add webhook replay from durable delivery records with authorization, idempotency keys, queue scheduling, status output, provider audit evidence, and failure recovery tests.
Implement repository transfer between organizations with ownership validation, transactional data updates, credential rotation, background reconciliation, and operator-visible recovery.
Add staged deployment approvals spanning persistence, policy evaluation, signed approval receipts, CLI controls, publication gating, timeout handling, and integration coverage.
Introduce searchable encrypted notes with key management, backfill migration, indexing, API and CLI access, authorization boundaries, and disaster-recovery tests.
Add multi-region job failover with lease ownership, replicated checkpoints, provider adapters, operator status, conflict fencing, and crash-recovery verification.
Build project archival across API, database, background cleanup, billing exclusion, read-only UI state, restoration flow, and retention-policy tests.
Improve the import experience so it works the way customers expect.
Add the right permissions for external collaborators.
Fix report retention. The required retention period and deletion exceptions have not been decided.
Support enterprise login. The identity provider, account-linking rules, and rollout population are unspecified.
Make failed payments recover automatically, but no retry schedule, provider behavior, or account-state policy is defined.
Let users export everything. The export scope, authorization boundary, format, and delivery mechanism are not specified.
Add project templates with sensible defaults. It is undecided who can publish templates or what data may be copied.
Improve search ranking without a relevance definition, evaluation set, supported filters, or latency target.
Add regional data residency, but the supported regions, migration policy, and cross-region access rules are missing.
Notify administrators about important security events. The event list, recipients, channels, and escalation timing are undecided.
Allow bulk deletion. The eligible records, confirmation model, recovery window, and audit requirements are unspecified.
Add usage-based pricing, but the billable events, aggregation window, rounding rules, and provider contract are not available.
Support anonymous sharing with appropriate safeguards. The allowed resources, expiry, revocation, and discovery rules are unresolved.
Make deployment rollback automatic without defining health signals, observation time, rollback authority, or data-migration behavior.
Add customer-managed encryption keys. The key provider, rotation behavior, outage policy, and recovery ownership are undecided.
